# pve_node_certificate (Resource)

Node certificate ordered from an ACME CA (create orders, update renews, destroy revokes).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_certificate" "example" {
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `filename` (String) (default: pveproxy-ssl.pem)
- `force` (Boolean) Overwrite existing custom certificate. (default: 0)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/filename (also the `terraform import` format).
